projects.name: FindU
projects.description: Helping GenZ figure out their next steps after graduating high school.

ai.summary: FindU or 'Tinder for Colleges' - a startup Kenny co-founded with Wilson Overfield. Started as a classroom project. Helps high school students discover colleges through a swiping interface. Built after interviewing 50+ students. Team of 15+ people, raised seed funding, 5,000+ students onboarded. Features: personalized matching, scholarships, messaging, AI assistant, tasks.
